context: Adversarial finding Critical-2 (accepted; verified autocommit=True at snowflake.py ~629 and the new per-statement split loop at ~1370-1384, re-verify after rebase). The SCD2 close-old-then-insert-new operation (operations.yaml scd entries) is no longer atomic: if the insert fails, the close has committed and rollback cannot restore it. The platform supports explicit transactions; use them, or record a deliberate non-atomicity decision. Staging worktree: wt-cloud-executor-loader, file benchbox/platforms/snowflake.py.
